purpose: Immutable record of a bounded GET-only reconciliation of ALL EIGHT SEED_SET keys against the CURRENT dedicated staging WABA on 2026-08-24. It exists because the committed ledger carried 2026-07-31 claims that are WABA-BLIND: several were proven correct here, two templates proved ABSENT despite being recorded APPROVED/UTILITY, and one had already been proven a MARKETING mismatch. Readiness must derive from THIS current-WABA truth, never from the historical claims alone.

identity_boundary_correction.statement: Every reading in this sweep was taken through an operator pinned to the HISTORICAL MIXED identity triple (genuine QuickFurno Staging app, but the PRODUCTION WABA and PRODUCTION phone). Live diagnosis on 2026-08-25 proved the actual dedicated staging/test WABA is a different asset. The eight results below therefore describe the historical remote identity, NOT the actual staging WABA.
identity_boundary_correction.readiness_consequence: No QF-MVP-40 readiness or canary decision for the actual staging WABA may rest on any reading in this file. Actual-staging template state must be re-measured, read-only, against the corrected identity boundary first.

privacy: No token, app secret, phone number, WABA id or remote template id appears here. No Meta request or response body is reproduced: none was captured, and fabricating one would be evidence forgery. Only each operator's own printed classification lines are recorded.

method.statement: Every reading used an existing one-shot operator in its default dry-run mode. In that mode the create path is structurally unreachable: createOnce is only invoked when the pure decide() returns post:true, which requires BOTH --execute and --owner-authorized-once. Each run printed POST_ATTEMPT_COUNT=0.

classifier_capability_note.strict_verifier_generic: scripts/mvp/communication/submit-meta-templates.mjs --reconcile-only reaches RECONCILED_APPROVED only after an exact single name+language row, an explicit category equality check, templatesAreIdentical() against the committed payload using the REMOTE components, a known APPROVED status and a present remote template id. Its create path is unreachable in that mode, so create_post_count is structurally 0. It is the strict verifier used to close the vendor_onboarding_reminder gap on 2026-08-25.
classifier_capability_note.loose_readings_remaining: client_matching_update v1 only. That key is QUARANTINED and NOT READY, so no readiness decision rests on a loose reading.
classifier_capability_note.statement: A STRICT classifier reaches ALREADY_CREATED only after matching name, language, an accepted status, the pinned category AND a full semantic comparison against the committed payload using the REMOTE components. A LOOSE classifier (the earlier R7B/R7I model) matches name, language and status only. For a loose reading the category recorded below is taken from the operator's own printed "existing row" line, and NO semantic match is asserted.

strict_proof.supersedes_classification: The 2026-08-24 reading of this key was LOOSE (name+language+status only). This strict reconciliation replaces that classification. The earlier reading is not deleted; it is simply no longer the strongest proof.

summary.statement: Only a PRESENT_APPROVED_UTILITY current-WABA state may count towards mapping readiness. ABSENT keys are not ready no matter what the 2026-07-31 historical record says.

authorities_explicitly_not_granted.statement: This sweep is a reading. It grants nothing. It does not authorise creating the ABSENT templates, mapping any template, arming any provider, or any production action.

historical_evidence_non_claim.statement: The 2026-07-31 submission and reconciliation records observed a PREVIOUS WABA context and are accurate for what they observed. They are referenced unchanged by their ledger entries and are NOT amended. This artifact is ADDITIVE: it records what is true on the CURRENT dedicated staging WABA today, which the WABA-blind packet and ledger cannot express on their own.
